tasks.label: Deploy (remote)
tasks.command: ssh "${input:deploySshAlias}" 'set -euo pipefail; cd "${input:appRoot}"; git fetch origin main; git checkout -B main origin/main; docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.ip.override.yml up -d'

tasks.label: Logs (remote)
tasks.command: ssh "${input:deploySshAlias}" 'cd "${input:appRoot}" && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.ip.override.yml logs -f --tail=200'

tasks.label: Restart (remote)
tasks.command: ssh "${input:deploySshAlias}" 'cd "${input:appRoot}" && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.ip.override.yml restart'
